ྈrta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa las rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can gyi sgrub skor me yi phreng ba zhes bya ba lho gter 'bras bu'i tshul du sbas pa bzhugs sa

tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ rta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa las rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can gyi sgrub skor me yi phreng ba zhes bya ba lho gter 'bras bu'i tshul du sbas pa bzhugs so:
ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ dpal pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes: rta mgrin ngo bo yin pa'i phyir: de nyid nag po'i sgrub pa bstan:

'di la gsum ste: dang po rdzas gsag pa: bar du sgrub pa: tha ma las sbyor bstan pa'o: dang po ni: dur khrod la sogs dben pa'i gnas su: dkyil 'khor dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag zla gam dmar po: de'i phyi rim rtsibs bzhi: de'i phyi mu khyud thod phreng khyams sgo rdzogs dang bcas pa bris la: dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bum pa rdzas ldan mgul chings mthing ga bya: de'i steng du spod kyis bran pa'i gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba rta mgos mtshan pa: pad 'dab tshe ril dang bcas pa bsham mo: gzhan yang gtor tshogs mchod pa ci 'byor pa bsham: mda' bzhi gri bzhi tshon skud kyi drwa ba dang bcas pa bsham mo: gnyis pa sgrub pa ni: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang bgegs la gtor ma byin la:
swa bhā ba
sa sbyang:

stong pa'i ngang las: dkyil 'khor bum pa dang bcas pa mi dmigs pa las: gzhal yas khang e mthing nag 'bar ba: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta bab yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su: bdud bzhi klu rigs lnga bsnol ba'i steng: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan gyi steng du: bdag nyid rig pa'i ngo bo hrīḥmathing nag 'od du 'bar ba las 'od zer 'phros: rgyal ba rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul: sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs: klu dang sde brgyad gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad: tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las: ma hā kro dha ha ya grī wa hūm̐: zhes brjod pa las: bdag nyid rta mgrin nag po: sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: spyan gsum sdang mig tu bsgrad cing khrag ltar du g.yo ba: zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba: rno dbal dang ldan pa'i mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa: dbu gtsug na rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad 'tsher ba: phyag g.yas rdo rjes yu ba byas pa'i ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkha' la phyar bas dgra bgegs kyi mgo lus dum bur gtub pa: g.yon pas lcags kyu dang zhags pa bsnams pas dgra bgegs kyi dbang po bsdams shing snying nas 'dren pa: zhabs gnyis 'dor thabs su bsgrad pa: sku stod la zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang: sku smad la stag lpags kyi sham thabs gsol ba: de'i steng du glang chen gyi ko rlon dang dar nag gi ber chen gsol ba: thod pa skam po lngas dbu la brgyan pa:

sbrul rigs lngas sku la brgyan pa: gdol pa nag po'i do shal dang: mi mgo khrag 'dzag lnga bcus do shal byas pa: lcags kyi ral pa nag po spyi bor bcings shing sku rgyab tu 'phyang pa rting rtser sleb pa: ral pa sprugs pa'i skra gseb nas sprul pa'i khro chung mang po skar ltar 'khrugs pas dgra bgegs klu gdon gnod byed thams cad thal bar brlag cing 'joms par byed pa: tshur 'dus rang lus ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas khro chung zhal phyir bstan pa bar mtshams med pas gtams pa: mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'khor ba: me dpung dmar nag rab tu 'bar ba'i klong na i ha hi'i sgra sgrog pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs par bsgom:
de nas/

shar gyi rtsibs steng du sku'i rta mgrin dkar po cha lugs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa: g.yas ral gri 'khor lo'i yu ba can phyar ba: g.yon pas lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o: lhor yon tan gyi rta mgrin ser po g.yas rin po ches yu ba byas pa'i ral gri dang: g.yon pas zhags pa 'dzin pa'o: nub tu gsung gi rta mgrin dmar po g.yas pad+mas yu ba byas pa'i ral gri dang: g.yon pas dbang gi lcags sgrog 'dzin pa'o: byang du phrin las kyi rta mgrin ljang gu g.yas rgya gram gyis yu ba byas pa'i ral gri dang: g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa'o: de dag kyang gtso bo ltar phyogs dang mthun pa'i ber dang dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs pa: kun kyang spyi bo na rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad lhang lhang 'tsher ba'o:
de ltar ting 'dzin bskyed pa'i rim pa rdzogs nas: de nas bzlas pa sngags kyi rim pa ni:
gtso 'khor lha lnga rang rang gi spyi bor oṃ dkar po: mgrin par āḥdamar po: thugs kar hūm̐ mthing sngon gsal ba las:
'bru gsum

brjod pas sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs: bdag gtso bo'i thugs srog hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas: bde chen dbang drag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas: rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs: bdag gtso 'khor la chu la chu 'dres pa ltar dbyer med du gyur
par bsam:

oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyis dbang bskur: dbang rtags su rta mgos rta skad thengs gsum bton pas: khams gsum dbang du bsdus: srid gsum zil gyis mnan: ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdus: klu dang sa bdag rgyal bsen gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad par bsgom: thugs kar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hrīḥyig nag po la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor bar gyur:
thog mar rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa nag po klu 'dul zhes bya ba 'di mi tshig gis bar ma chod par bzlas pa bya'o:
oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa:
bsnyen pa'i grangs tshang bar bzla'o: grangs thems nas sham bu 'di btags:
nā ga rak+sha nag po ti pa tsa mā ra ya phaṭa:

ces rang bzhin sgrub na bdun 'bum rab sum 'bum tshad de: rtags sna tshogs 'ong bas gang la'ang skyon yon 'khu 'khrig mi bya'o: mdze'am smyo 'bog brgyal nad gdon la bye ba thems par bya'o: de nas spyi dril drag sngags bzla: gong gi sham bur:

yak+sha kā la chen po gnod byed pho mo'i srog rtsa la rbad rbad: snying rtsa la rbad rbad: sha la rbad rbad: khrag la rbad rbad: rus pa la rbad rbad: lpags pa la rbad rbad: klad pa la rbad rbad: sa bdag klu gnyan rgyal bsen gyi yid la rbad rbad: yak+sha kā la chen po sa bdag klu gnyan rgyal bsen gyi tsit+ta zung zung: tsit+ta rmugs rmugs: tsit+ta phyungs phyungs: tsit+ta gtubs gtubs: tsit+ta myog myog: tsit+ta thuṃ thuṃ ril ril rbad rbad ya ya bh+yo bh+yo: klu dang rgyal bsen gyi srog rtsa chod chod: snying rtsa phyungs phyungs: gtubs gtubs: khaṃ khaṃ: rbad rbad: dum bur rbud rbud: nā ga rā tsa mā ra ya rbad rbad: sod sod: myog baṃ ril mā ra ya rbad ya:

zhes zur ma nyams par bzla: klu thub rtags la sbal sbrul bsad pa: rgya mtsho skam pa: glang dmar bsad pa dang: nags tshal bsregs pa: sdom sdig 'bu srin bsad pa: rin po che'i pho brang bshig pa dang: rgyal po thub rtags la lha khang bcom pa: lder so brdung ba: 'bag seng bcom pa: ban+de brdung ba dang: bsen mo thub rtags la bud med khyi nag sdom sdig spyang nag bcom pa: nad thul rtags la dam sri spyang nag bcom pa: chung sri byi la brdung mnan: lar rtags bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung: de nas dmigs pa ngar bskyed rig pa hur phyung brtson 'grus drag pos gnam lcags thog gi spu gri 'di khri tsho gcig bzlas so: nges par mdze 'don na: sngags bzlas rdzas kyi sgrub pa sogs gtso bor bla ma'i zhal shes dang phyag len mthong ba brgyud pa ltar bya dgos so:

oṃ tsakra du na bdag la gnod byed 'gong po pho mo'i mgo la chom chom: zhe sdang sha la myag myag: nā ga'i sha la myag myag: 'dod chags khrag la rbud rbud: nā ga'i khrag la rbud rbud: nga rgyal snying la gzer gzer: nā ga'i snying la gzer gzer: 'grim 'grim: dbang po yan lag nas zung zung: nā ga'i snying dang dbang po yan lag nas zung zung: rtsa rgyus la thuṃ ri li li: nā ga'i rtsa rgyus la thuṃ ri li li: rtsa thang rtsa thang: nā ga'i rtsa la thang thang: khrag byed rus la khruṃ khruṃ: 'ching byed srog la rbad rbad: nā ga'i srog la rbad rbad: brgyal byed rtsa la rbud rbud: nā ga'i rtsa la rbud rbud: nā ga rā tsa sod sod: bying bying: thib thib: myos myos: sod sod: rbad rbad: nan nan: nā ga rā tsa'i srog la thib thib: phob phob: snying tig steng la phob phob: don snying lnga la phob phob: spu gri 'bar bas gnod byed pho mo'i snying nas drongs shig: nā ga rā tsa thuṃ ril dza: mā ra ya baṃ ril rbad ya:

zhes grangs thems na mdze nad smin ma byi ba dang sna zhom pa yang thon na: 'gos zin tsam la smos ci dgos: mdze rigs yod pa la ma byung ba la 'di yi bsnyen pa byas na the tshom med do: gzhan yang 'go ba'i nad klu nad gnyan nad rgyal bsen gdon gang yin yang nye mi nus te: gnam lcags mkhar la bskal pa'i me 'bar ba dang 'dra'o: shin tu thu na klu srog spu gri'i sngags 'di khri tsho tsam sbyar te bzlas so:
oṃ nā ga du na tsan+dhe tsan+dhe mi li mi li ban+dha ban+dha nā ga ni swā hā:

de ltar bsnyen sgrub thems na mdze nad chu bur can yang phan no: gzhan gnod 'tshe nad rigs thams cad la the tshom med do: drag po'i las gtad sel: mnan pa: mdze'am: nad ngan: ro khur: rlung 'khor: phra men: gter 'don: sa gnyan brko ba: brag gnyan bshig pa: mtsho brdol ba: lu ma bsrub pa: mna' bskyal ba: bya ba rtsub las gang la yang 'di'i bsnyen sgrub thems na: rang nyid rdo rje'i gur dang 'dra'o: sngags dang rdzas 'brel na lag na rdo rjes kyang gzhig par mi nus so: de rnams ni spyir nad gdon thams cad dang khyad par klu 'dul sngags yin no: ༈ da ni rgyal bsen 'dul ba bstan: dus kyi tha ma la rgyal po 'dis 'gro ba mtho dman med pa la gnod tshabs che zhing: khyad par dam sri yin pas chos pa rnams la bar du gcod pas: 'di'i srog 'phrog spu gri'i drag sngags kyis 'dul ba ni:

oṃ ma hā pad+ma shrī he ru ka badz+ra ru ta ka: kro ta hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: ban+dha hring dza: badz+ra rā dza: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: e ā ral+li hūm̐ hrīḥdza: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: oṃ lhang lhang: tser tser: thuṃ thuṃ: shel shel swā hā: hrīḥbadz+ra rak+sha rā tsa'i tsit+ta zung zung: kha rag sme sha rbad rbad: 'khu na dum bur shig shig: dha na rak+sha tsit+ta phyungs phyungs: ldog na rak+sha tsit+ta rbad rbad: tri gtub dza: rā tsa thuṃ: a ti rbad: mā ra ya thuṃ: mā ra ya: shel ging dkar po gtubs: mā ra ya dza: snying rtsa nan: pra sa ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐ nan: rbad rbad: ra tri ra tri nan: mā ra ya dza: kaṃ kaṃ ku ru nan: pra sa ma ya hūm̐ nan: rā tsa kha thuṃ: rā tsa trig nan: tri rā dza s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: hūm̐ phaṭa nan:

bdun nam nyer gcig tsam re rtags dang bstun la bya'o: mang na kho brgyal bar 'gyur ro: brgyal sangs nas gnod pas thul ba dang chun pa'i rtags byung na dam bor ro: mna' bsgag pa la tshod ran pa gces so: nus pa ldan pas tshod med par ar la gtad na kho srog dang bral te sdig che'o: lar sngags 'di zhag re la tshar bdun re bzlas na zhag bdun nas thul lo: rtags la lha khang bcom pa: ban+de brdung ba: lder so bcom pa: khyi dkar bsad pa: byis pa brdung ba: 'bag seng brdung ba: phyag 'tshal ba: bka' nyan pa: mna' bskul ba: du ba la sogs byung na tshod ran par bya'o: ༈ da ni drag po rdzas rgod kyi sbyor ba bstan pa ni: nus pa sngags: ngar skyed rdzas: sngags dang rdzas gnyis nus pa 'dra ste gnyis ka bstun na ri rab thal bar brlag nus so: de'i rdzas ni: mu zi nag po: gu gul nag po: gla rtsi: sman chen: mkhan dmar rtsa ba: spru ba'i rtsa ba: shing kun: sgog gcig ma: spyang tsher: mi khyi ra'i khrag: spyang dug: bong nga: thal chen: thog lcags: rma bya'i mdongs: yungs dkar: yung nag: ke tshe: shang tshe: gcan gzan mche sder: spyang rnga: 'phar ba: khra: glag: g.yi: gsa' rnams kyi sha khrag: g.yag rgod kyi rwa: gtsod rwa: phag rgod mche ba: de rnams sbyar la zangs sam lcags sam smyug dong ngam rwa'i nang du blugs la: gong gi klu dang rgyal po'i sngags kha bsgyur: gong gi bsnyen sngags rnams rdzas la btab nas chang rgod dam khye'u'i chu dang sbyar te rlon pa byas pa'am:

ril bu la sogs gang rung bya'o: rjes kyang sngags kyis kha gso: rlangs pa ma yal bar byas la: dgos dus kha gso ba ni: rtsa ba'i sngags brgya'am stong sogs kyis klu dang rgyal po sogs gang bsrung ba'i sngags tshan gsum: pho mo gang bsrung ba la khri tsho re rab: gzhon nu rnams la stong tsho re: byol song la brgya re: zho chang la nyer gcig res chog: gag lhog gzer gsum shu ba skrang pa: gza' gdon: nad ngan ro khur: drag las: yul gsar 'dzin pa rnams la skam gsher ngar btag rig pas dpyad do: mdor na mthu byed hom zor ser ba bsrung ba bsreg mnan smyo 'bog 'dul: sngags pa lto ru btang byugs dud pas bdug bu ga bsgags lus la 'chang sa la gtor nang rgyas rdzas zlog: thams cad 'di dang ldan na lha srin sde brgyad gang gis kyang mi tshugs so: bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar bar mthong ste 'da' mi srid do: mdor na rang la ci ri 'di la ri: sra ba'i go rno ba'i mtshon 'jigs pa'i skyabs srung ba'i mkhar: 'jig rten du 'byung bar dkon te: shi theb snying gi bu gcig las spel du mi rung bstan du mi rung ste: pad+ma bdag gi thugs bcud do: snying gi man ngag dam pa 'di kho na'o: ༈ 'di'i lag len ni gong du dkyil 'khor sgrub rdzas dang bcas te: zhag bdun nam bcu bzhi nyer gcig tu bsgrubs la: dbang dang dngos grub blangs la: rjes su ting 'dzin bskyed rim gsal ba'i ngang nas smra ba bcad de bzlas pa kho nas chog go:

༈ gong du spyan drangs pa bzlas pa'i thun mtshams sam dus bzhi'am nang nub la sogs spyan 'dren mchod bstod rgyas par bya ste: rnga dang rol mo'i sgra bsgrags dbyangs snyan drag gtum gsum dang ldan pas 'di skad do:

hūm̐ hrī: bde chen dbang drag rol pa'i pho brang nas: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba e yi klong: bskal pa'i me dpung dmar nag 'bar klong nas: dregs pa'i mnga' bdag rta nag 'bar ba'i sku: gnod sbyin nag po chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: dregs pa ru tra ma lus 'joms mdzad lha: gdug pa'i tshogs 'joms rta nag lcags ral can: klu 'dul nag po bdud dpung 'joms mdzad pa: rnal 'byor bdag gi sngon gyi dam tshig gis: che btsan khyod ni spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: klu bdud gnyan chen 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: rgyal bsen dam sri 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: dregs pa sde brgyad 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: mdze nad gnyan lhog 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: smyo 'bog brgyal nad 'dul phyir= khams gsum dbang du sdud phyir= srid gsum zil gyis gnon phyir= dbang dang dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs su gsol:
de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni:

hūm̐: srid gsum ye nas gtor gzhong du: snang srid thams cad gtor mar sbyar: 'khor 'das yongs sgrol chen po'i tshogs: dbang chen rigs lnga'i tshogs la 'bul: hūm̐: stong gsum stong gi gtor gzhong du: ri rab 'bar ba'i dpal bshos btsugs: skye 'gro sems can grangs las 'das: rta nag dregs pa'i tshogs la 'bul: bhan+dha 'bar ba'i gtor gzhong du: dgra bgegs sha rus thod tshil spungs: zhag dang rlangs gsur chi li li: nag po lcags ral thugs dam bskang: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas sgra snyan mchod pa'i tshogs: gzugs sgra dri ro mchod sprin rnams: rta mgrin nag po'i thugs dam bskang: bdud rtsi gtor chen rak+ta'i mtsho: sbyor sgrol ting 'dzin mchod tshogs dang: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin gyis: dbang chen lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: rnal 'byor bdag ni sgrub pa po: 'dod pa'i don la gsol 'debs kyis: rtags dang mtshan bzang bstan pa dang: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod:
ces mchod pa phul nas bstod cing phrin las bcol ba ni:

hūm̐: bde chen dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: ha ya grī wa mthing nag 'bar ba'i sku: zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis 'dor thabs bsgrad: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dbal mche ba gtsigs: dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa kruṃ kruṃ gsol: rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog: khams gsum dbang sdud srid gsum zil gyis gnon: snyan nas 'brug sgrog dregs pa brgyal zhing 'bog: lcags kyi ral pas sa gzhi khyab par sprug: khro chung mang pos dgra bgegs thal bar rlog: spyan gsum dmar zlum sdang mig phyogs bcur bsgrad: dregs pa pho mo 'dar zhing sngangs par byed: shangs nas rlung 'tshubs dgra bgegs thal bar rlog: 'bar ba'i zhal bgrad sgra skad bton pa yis: srid pa gsum po zhal du gsol zhing rol: phyag g.yas ral gri 'bar bas dgra bgegs gtub: g.yon pa lcags kyus 'dzin cing zhags pas bsdams: klu rnams 'dul phyir sbrul rigs lnga yis brgyan: 'khor ba stongs mdzad mgo phreng lnga bcus spras: glang chen ko rlon stobs bcu lhun gyis rdzogs: zhing gi g.yang gzhis dregs pa ru tra sgrol: stag sham nga rgyal dregs pa dbang du sdud: dar nag ber chen snang srid zil gyis gnon: ba spu'i rtse la me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro: khro tshogs mang po nam mkha'i rlung ltar 'tshubs: zhabs gnyis 'dor thabs klu dang dgra bgegs mnan: rta nag 'bar ba'i thugs dam dus la bab:

bdag ni dbang chen sgrub pa'i dam tshig can: khyed kyi thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i tshe: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dus la bab: nag po klu rgyal 'dul ba'i dus la bab: nā ga rak+sha 'dul ba'i dus la bab: gnyan chen sde brgyad 'dul ba'i= rgyal rigs dkar po 'dul ba'i= bram ze dmar po 'dul ba'i= rje rigs ser po 'dul ba'i= dmangs rigs ljang gu 'dul ba'i= gdol pa nag po 'dul ba'i= rgyal bsen pho mo 'dul ba'i= pe kar srog bdag 'dul ba'i= dam sri dkar nag 'dul ba'i= lha srin sde brgyad 'dul ba'i dus la bab: rang bzhin chos kyi sku las ma g.yos kyang: dregs pa 'dul phyir rta nag khros pa'i sku: gnod sbyin nag po klu dang rgyal bsen gshed: bka' yi gtor ma sha khrag dmar gyis brgyan: rngams shing rngams shing zhal du kha raṃ khā hi: nag po kun rgyug zhal du kha raṃ khā hi: sprul pa nag po'i zhal du kha raṃ khā hi: che btsan yon tan ma lus rdzogs pa'i sku: mthu rtsal stobs ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam tshig gnyan po'i thugs dam gnad nas bskul: bdag gis bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

ces mchod bskul la brtson par bya'o: ༈ las sbyor tha ma dbang dang dngos grub blang ba ste: gzhung ltar zhag bdun bcu bzhi la sogs grangs thems nas sam: 'on te rtags khyad par can byung na dngos grub blang ste: bum pa gtor ma dang bcas pa ma bral ba spyi bor bzhag ste:

rnam pa bum pa dang gtor ma mi dmigs pa las: ngo bo rta mgrin nag po 'khor rta mgrin rigs bzhi dang bcas pa 'ur 'ur thug thug chem chem: rta skad thengs gsum tser tser bton pas: stong gsum 'ur 'ur rgya mtsho khyom khyom: ri rab ldeg ldeg drag shul dang ldan par bdag gi spyi bor byon: gang gi nus pa yongs su rdzogs pas bdag la dbang bskur bas: klu dang sa bdag rgyal bsen dam sri 'byung po sde brgyad thams cad kha 'dar snying 'dar: brgyal 'bog myos lkugs rengs 'dar yed yed mig hrig hrig: bka' nyan las byed bro bor dam las mi 'da' bar bsam: 'ga' zhig ni rgya mtsho'i 'gram du bros te phyir mi ldog par bar mtshams mtshon cha'i 'khor lo dang me dpung gis chod par bsam:
slob ma rjes su 'dzin na yang de ltar nan du bskyed la dbang bskur ro:

hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i tshul bstan pa: khro bo chen po gshegs su gsol: sprul pa'i khro rgyal gshegs nas kyang: rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: sku yi sgo nas dbang mchog skur: lus kyi nad gdon zhi bar mdzod: gsung gi sgo nas dbang mchog skur: ngag la nus pa bskyed du gsol: thugs kyi sgo nas dbang mchog skur: yid la bde stong sbar du gsol: yon tan sgo nas dbang mchog skur: mthu stobs rtsal chen bskyed du gsol: phrin las sgo nas dbang mchog skur: nad gdon bgegs rnams tshar chod cig: bum pas dbang bskur gzhal yas chen po'i mchog: gtor mas dbang bskur lha dang gnyis su med: rta mchog sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: ma lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang bzhi mchog: skal ldan bdag la dus 'dir yongs rdzogs nas: sku bzhi lhun grub phrin las rnam bzhi brnyes: rgya chen rgyun mi 'chad pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ hūm̐: e ā ral+li hūm̐ hrīḥdza: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: wā ka a bhi ṣiñca ā: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sarba a bhi ṣiñca hrī:

zhes gnas bzhir gtug cing bum chu spyi bor blugs pas rta mgos mtshan nas rta skad thengs gsum thon par bsam: ngag tu blud pas nus pa thogs pa med par bsam: gtor ma dngos grub tu rol: gal te sgrub thabs 'di snying dang 'dra ba'i bu la ster na'ang: gong gi dkyil 'khor rdzas bsham: bla mas bskyed rim rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa brgya'am stong: gzhan gong bsnyen thems pas ci rigs bzlas te: mchod bstod bskul pa rnams bya'o: tshogs la sogs bla ma'i gzhung ltar byas la: slob mas phyag 'tshal maṇ+ḍal dang dbang yon phul: slob ma la rang gis blang ba ltar bskur bar bya'o: lar 'di shin tu gnyan cing 'khu ldog che bas snod ldan lo gsum mam bdun 'grogs pa'i bu 'ga' re min par spel du mi rung ngo: o rgyan bdag gi thugs bcud dam pa 'di: da lta'i dus su spel ba'i gnas med pas: ma 'ongs dus na 'dzam gling bod kyi yul: klu dang sa bdag rgyal bsen dbang byas te: mdze dang gag lhog smyo 'bog brgyal nad sogs: mi rnams mi bde sna tshogs gtong bar byed: de lta'i dus su 'phrad chog thob chog 'di: thugs kyi mdzod brtol ma 'ongs don phyir sbas: phyi ma'i dus na skyes bu blo stobs can: snod ldan bu dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas: snyigs ma'i dus na 'gro don dpag med shog: yos lo rta zla'i tshes pa bco lnga la: bsam yas rta mgrin ar+ya pa lo'i gling:
rje 'bangs grogs lnga
khri srong lde'u btsan mkhar chen bza' nam mkha'i snying po sangs rgyas ye shes rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/
lo tsā chen po lnga:
lang gro lo tsā bai ro tsa na legs sbyin nyi ma ska cog rnam gnyis so//

dbang chen dmar nag rgyud dang man ngag bcas: dpag tu med pa'i bka' rdzogs ma lus gtad: rta mgrin nag po lcags ral sgrub pa'i skor: dbus dang phyogs bzhir gter kha lnga ru sbas: de dag kun gyi zab rgyas mthar thug 'di: mkha' ris gdan drangs mon mkhar steng bzhugs tshe: a tsar ye shes bka' yi yi ge mkhan: bse sgrom smug po snod kyi nang du bstsal: gnam skas brag la thugs kyi yang gter sbas: gter bdag rnams kyis bka' 'di thub par srungs: dus la bab tshe chos bdag bu la gtod: des kyang kha gsag stong zhus mkhan po dang: snod min ma spel gdams pa 'tsho shes gyis: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: sa ma ya: kha thaṃ: rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ

kho bo dus mtha'i gter ston rat+na gling*/ khyi lo rta zla'i tshes gcig snga dro la// lho brag gnam skas can gyi brag gshags nas// kun yid ches phyir khrom gter byas nas bton// dam med 'dod pa can la mi bstan te// snying gi bu mchog byung na ster bar nges// pha srol bu yis ma nyams rjes 'jug rnams// rta mgrin skor rnams lo skor gcig la bka' rgya ma grol te de rjes bya lo phag zla'i nya la/ shog ser zheng sor bzhi/ dkyus mtho do ba zhig las thang dkar du bshus so// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog/ //
